title: OnekoCat
description: Ever wanted a Minecraft pet to keep you company? OnekoCat stays right on your screen. Download it and never craft alone again!
body:
## 🐱 OnekoCat

Your new desktop cat, now in Minecraft.

He chases your cursor. Naps when you go idle. Purrs when you pet him. 
Meows when you click him. Haunts your menus like he owns the place.

Drag his bed wherever you want. Toggle everything in the config.
Lightweight. Cute. Probably judging you. 👀
